stem:
Elias has three containers of cooking oil. The table shows the volume of cooking oil in each container.

Elias's Cooking Oil

| Container | Volume (L) |
|-----------|------------|
| X         | 0.946      |
| Y         | 0.502      |
| Z         | 1.42       |

Which list shows the containers in order from least to greatest volume in liters?
